title: C2MS 학습 손실을 MSE에서 L1로 교체
hypothesis: The top single-pass pansharpening models (ARConv, CANNet, U2Net+PAKAN) all train with an L1 loss while C2MS uses MSE. L1 gives every pixel error the same gradient magnitude, so small but widespread errors such as the band ratio of the high band may be reduced more evenly, lowering SAM with PSNR kept.

arms.C2MS: unchanged C2MS architecture (SSA-MRN K4 + W2), fresh 150-epoch cosine training with L1 instead of MSE on the original and the 2x coarser pairs (run folder name keeps the 54 arm name C2MS)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data)

precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0; earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as C2MS)
loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs; the 54 trainer is used with only its four MSE expressions replaced by absolute errors (train.py); history fields keep the 54 names train_mse/coarse_train_mse but hold mean absolute errors
sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS (QB, GF2, WV3; WV2 for the transfer test), phase 2

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB, 0.04 dB for 2+ seeds
judgement.sam_goal: QB dSAM <= -0.15 deg (first) / <= -0.28 deg (stretch) with dPSNR >= -0.04 dB, reported separately
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse validation

limits: L1 changes the relative weight of the coarse term

constraints.training: user authorized the QB seed 42 L1 run on 2026-10-26

coarse_weight_note: coarse weight kept at 1.0; under L1 the coarse term is relatively larger than under MSE (expected about 0.5x vs 0.26x of the original term on QB); the first-epoch ratio is recorded in history
control_policy: No new control run. The official control is the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed: a same-seed C2MS retrained in 57 differed from it by only +0.009 dB / -0.003 deg / -0.004 on RR, but by -0.306 dB on RR2 and 1.124 in the observation ratio. The 57 retrained C2MS is reported as a second reference; RR2/observation guards that fail against 53 but pass against 57 are read as run-to-run variance. If the 3-seed guards end within 0.02 dB of a tolerance, same-code 3-seed controls are added.

stages.screen: QB seed 42 (approved by the user on 2026-10-26)
stages.screen_gate: test RR SAM <= -0.05 deg and RR PSNR >= -0.04 dB against the 53 control, with validation in the same direction -> QB seeds 43 and 44 (paired 3-seed v2.3 against 53)
stages.expansion: GF2/WV3 seeds 42-44 and the WV2 transfer only if the QB 3-seed result is an improvement or meets the SAM goal, after user approval
